title: Restore a motor vehicle repairer licence
summary: You can restore your motor vehicle repairer licence online if it expired less than 3 months ago.
intro:
If your motor vehicle repairer licence expired less than 3 months ago, you can restore your licence online.

To look up your motor vehicle repairer licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Your motor vehicle repairer licence must have expired less than 3 months ago.
what_you_need: Your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your full personal details

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to restore your licence.

more_info.text: Your licence is considered to have been renewed from the day it expired.
If your licence has been expired for more than 3 months, you’ll need to apply for a new licence.
Your motor vehicle repair business must not trade until it has a valid licence.

faqs.q: How do I check my motor vehicle repairer licence number?
faqs.a: To look up your motor vehicle repairer licence number and details, visit Verify NSW.

faqs.q: What do I need to restore my licence online?
faqs.a: You will need your licence number, your renewal number (as shown on your renewal notice), or your full personal details, and your fee payment.
